description:
As a Web Orders user, I want to log in with valid credentials so that I can access the Web Orders application and perform order management activities.

   
[Web Orders](http://secure.smartbearsoftware.com/samples/TestComplete11/WebOrders/Products.aspx)
acceptanceCriteria:
User can access the Web Orders login page.
User can enter a valid username (Tester).
User can enter a valid password (test).
User can successfully click the Login button.
User is redirected to the Web Orders landing page after successful authentication.
No authentication error message is displayed.
User session is established and application menus are accessible.
